hypothesis.method: Training diffusion models on synthetic neuroimaging data generated via physics-based brain emulation
hypothesis.problem: Overfitting of generative AI to real human brain scans due to limited diversity and annotative sparsity
hypothesis.goal: Achieve robust, generalizable generation of anatomically and functionally plausible brain structures across unseen demographics

messages.content: Propose one novel and scientifically valid research hypothesis in the field of artificial intelligence, in particular generative AI. Answer only with a JSON object of the form {"method": "...", "problem": "...", "goal": "..."} and nothing else.
